technical.summary: Extreme oversold bounce signals present but undermined by weak trend structure, negative money flow, and price below key short-term moving averages; low-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MCD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 57 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no senior conviction, while absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (307.84) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 57 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 extreme oversold with stochRSI bullish cross and EMA 50/200 bullish alignment create textbook mean-reversion bounce setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below both EMA 9 and EMA 21, negative CMF, weak ADX trend (15.47), no OBV confirmation, zero insider/institutional conviction, and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 307.84, NFP event in 2 days) make this a low-probability trap bounce into headwinds.
